title: Ambient restriction coefficient formula
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $J,S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix the signs on the coordinates outside $J$. The ambient restriction Fourier coefficient at $S$ equals the Fourier coefficient of the restricted function at the part of $S$ lying in $J$ if $S\subseteq J$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $J,S$ are finite subsets of the coordinate set
A fixed assignment of signs is given outside $J$
